description: Turn a buyer's award and a set of provider quotes into the engagement plan: every real charge subtracted, the margin per provider, and the one provider that clears both the margin floor and the deadline — or a refusal when none does. Choose this after an award and before engaging a provider: it decides whether the award is worth subcontracting and names the provider whose price, speed and margin all work. Do not choose this to obtain quotes, to run or monitor the subcontracted work, or for an award whose price is not yet agreed. Example requests: I won this job for $40; plan the subcontract and tell me what margin each provider leaves. | Which of these provider quotes still leaves me 25% after fees, and can all of them hit my deadline? | Show me the highest provider price I can accept on this award without going below my margin floor.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

assumptions.description: The customer's assumptions.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one key=value per line: settlement_fee_usd, overhead_usd, platform_fee_pct, min_margin_pct. The charges this run subtracts. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

award.description: The customer's award.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one key=value per line: buyer, buyer_price_usd, currency, deadline_hours, deliverables, acceptance. The awarded work: price, currency, deadline, deliverables and acceptance clauses. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quotes.description: The customer's quotes.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row and the columns provider, capability, price_usd, sla_hours, interface, measured_success_rate. What each provider would charge and how fast. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_subcontract_award_plan
title: Subcontract award plan and margin
